title: Azure Communication Services Email | Orchard Core
description:
A site that sends email needs a provider that delivers the messages, and a safe place to enter the credentials of that provider.

The Azure Communication Services Email module adds a provider that sends the email of your site through an Azure Communication Services resource. You enable the feature, enter a sender address and a connection string in the email settings, and check the result on the Email Test page.

In this video:
• How the providers work, and what you need
• Enable the feature
• Configure the provider
• Test the provider
• Good to know: the default provider, failures, and secrets
